planets.name: TOI-6564 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6564 with a 3.99-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-6564 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6564. Its orbit and size follow Battley et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
